entities.name: Vientiane–Boten Railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Boten–Vientiane railway is a Lao section of the Laos–China Railway (LCR), running between the capital Vientiane and the northern town of Boten on the border with Yunnan, China. The line was officially opened on 3 December 2021.
